column1: # Verbs whose recipient slot takes an a phrase after them: while no dative
# pronoun and no indirect object fills it, a + a noun phrase after the verb
# is the recipient, never where or when. Ho dato il libro a Parigi can only
# mean "to Paris"; Gli ho dato il libro a Parigi, with gli as the
# recipient, is "in Paris" (grammar.gram: recipient, vp.a-phrase). A verb
# that also takes a place or a time with a stays out: scrivere (ho scritto
# una lettera a Roma), mandare and spedire (a destination), vendere,
# insegnare, fornire, assegnare, dedicare, pagare, lasciare, passare,
# offrire (la cena a Roma), mostrare (un quadro a Venezia), consegnare (a
# domicilio). A time after any of them still says when (vp.a-time).
# Each verb is also in dative-verbs.tsv. One verb per line, as there, with
# an example. Drafted from dative-verbs.tsv for issue #53, to be checked by
# the owner.
